body:
**Blocked by #167.**

`/settings/roles` mixes configuration with day-to-day account work across five tabs.

### Change

- **Stay** at `/settings/roles`: "Role Definitions", "Assignment Rules".
- **Move** to a new `/system/accounts`: "Role Assignments", "Pending Accounts", "Orphaned Accounts". Components relocate unchanged — `CurrentAdminsList`, `RoleAssignmentSection`, `PendingAccountsList`, `OrphanedAccountsList`.
- Re-point the redirect in `src/app/(dashboard)/settings/user-roles/page.tsx`, which currently targets `/settings/roles?tab=assignments`.

### Permissions

- `/settings/roles` keeps **both** `SYSTEM_MANAGE_ROLES` and `SYSTEM_ASSIGN_ROLES` — someone who can only assign roles still needs to see the Assignment Rules governing what they assign.
- `/system/accounts` narrows to `SYSTEM_ASSIGN_ROLES`.

### Docs

`website/docs/getting-started/roles-and-permissions.md` documents the five-tab page.

### Verify

`npm test`; confirm both tab sets load under the right permissions.
